program.name: Bar & Bell
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: Pull-ups with a kettlebell: swings one day, presses the next, the bar every day.
program.about: The pull-up bar and the kettlebell together. Every day starts on the bar, then one day swings and squats with the bell, the other presses and rows it. The bar builds the back, the bell the hips and shoulders. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for a heavier bell and Level III slows every rep down.
